profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Full-stack software engineer focused on building practical, user-centered solutions. I enjoy tackling complex problems, working across the stack, and contributing to products that drive meaningful impact.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Contributed and launched ‘Everyday Care’, a client-facing feature that allows families to view their care team, message providers, and access personalized care plans based on child milestones.

- Contributed and launched to CareOS, a custom EHR system that supports provider workflows, task management, and clinical documentation.

- Led end-to-end development of a full-stack SWYC screening feature, spanning both client and provider interfaces. Features include a dynamic questionnaire engine, real-time scoring, and milestone tracking for children ages 2–60 months.

- Built an AI-powered provider-patient chat translator during an internal hackathon, leveraging in-house RAG, Temporal, and FHIR resources to enable real-time multilingual communication.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: A 17-week immersive software engineering program based in New York City, centered on full-stack JavaScript development, including Node.js, Express, Sequelize ORM for PostgreSQL databases, React and Redux; along with HTML, CSS, and CS fundamentals.
